article.hook: A song makes the room swell, and suddenly you aren’t just hearing it - you’re living it. For about two and a half days, the Moon in Pisces blurs the line between feeling and imagining, pulling emotions through the cracks and into a shared, unseen current.
article.lived: We slide into moments where sadness or joy surface without clear cause, like waves folding into one another. Conversations drift toward what’s hinted at, not said, and you notice the quiet gestures - an unspoken apology, a glance that carries weight. The world feels softer and more fluid, as if empathy leaks through the walls around us, mingling past and present in a slow, immersive pulse.
article.turn: The same porous heart that opens doors lets in what was never meant to be carried. Boundaries slip, and we collect feelings that aren’t ours - confusion, exhaustion, guilt - until we can’t tell what belongs inside and what should be shut out. When you carry everything, you carry nothing clearly.
moves: Listen to one song without doing anything else until you know every note by heart.
Say no to one request that isn’t yours to hold.
Draw or write a feeling you can’t put into words and leave it unfinished.
